facts.statement: The study used rats divided into five groups: a control group, a control group given simvastatin at 30 mg/kg, a group given trimethyltin (TMT), and two TMT groups given simvastatin at 10 mg/kg or 30 mg/kg.
facts.subject: animals

facts.statement: Neurotoxicity was induced by a single intraperitoneal injection of 8 mg/kg of trimethyltin.
facts.subject: animals

facts.statement: After three weeks of treatment, the researchers measured locomotor activity and learning and memory deficits using open-field and passive avoidance tests.
facts.subject: animals

facts.statement: The study measured hippocampal levels of nitrite, glutathione, glutathione peroxidase, myeloperoxidase, BACE1, mitochondrial membrane potential, and AMPK.
facts.subject: cells_or_tissue

facts.statement: Compared to the TMT group, simvastatin improved hippocampal glutathione, glutathione peroxidase, mitochondrial membrane potential, and AMPK, and reduced myeloperoxidase activity.
